The last time that happened was November 25, 1926, when there were 0-0 ties between the Chicago Cardinals-Chicago Bears and Akron Pros-Canton Bulldogs, and a 9-6 win by the Los Angeles Buccaneers over the Detroit Panthers. 
🏈The average margin of victory of 2.7 points is the lowest ever on Thanksgiving, with a minimum three games played.

2126362740960723037.author: AdamSchefter
2126362740960723037.text: The knee injury that Bears TE Colston Loveland suffered on Thanksgiving vs. the Lions is expected to land him on injured reserve, which would sideline him a minimum of four weeks, per sources. There still is additional testing to be done, but the current belief is that Loveland could return later this season.

For the 11th year, NFL players have the chance to share the causes that are important to them during Week 12 and 13 games as part of the league’s  “My Cause My Cleats” campaign.

More than 50 Houston Texans players will be wearing their cleats for Sunday’s matchup vs. the Ravens.For the fifth year in a row, Texans executives, coaches and staff also are participating in “My Cause My Kicks” to raise awareness for causes that are important to them.
